2610.06517.title: GCTAuto-encoder: A Cross modal Framework for Security Flaw Detection in IoT Networks
2610.06517.paper_summary: IoT encompasses diverse physical entities, from smart home devices to autonomous vehicles, creating a complex environment with heterogeneous security models. This heterogeneity makes IoT sub-systems vulnerable to various network attacks. Modern security systems must therefore be more robust to ensure security and privacy for IoT applications. A highly secure IoT system also demands real time insight, requiring data collection at the edge of the computing layer. This diversity calls for a unified security model applied at the foundational level. Edge intelligence offers a direct approach to handling device diversity. A key goal of edge intelligence in IoT is to extract insight from local data; security models can then use this data to build local node protections, and integrating AI models yields an advanced security solution. This research proposes a novel deep learning algorithm for effective intrusion detection at the edge, supported by a cloud-based IoT framework. We evaluate the proposed cross modal deep learning algorithm against baseline models. The contribution is a cross domain Deep Neural Network (DNN) algorithm for intrusion detection. The objective is to assess a multi-method deep learning model to detect intrusions in IoT systems at the edge via community detection with modeled attention. We evaluate GCT auto-encoder, a novel framework integrating edge intelligence to identify security flaws. The model significantly improves performance and efficiency. On a network intrusion IoT dataset covering multiple attack scenarios, it achieved 0.908 accuracy, reduced learning loss to 0.00156, and outperformed existing approaches.
2610.06517.paper_summary_zh: 物聯網涵蓋了多樣的實體，從智慧家居設備到自主車輛，創造了一個具有異質安全模型的複雜環境。這種異質性使得物聯網子系統容易受到各種網路攻擊。因此，現代安全系統必須更加穩健，以確保物聯網應用的安全性和隱私。高度安全的物聯網系統還要求實時洞察，這需要在計算層的邊緣進行數據收集。這種多樣性呼喚在基礎層面上應用統一的安全模型。邊緣智能提供了一種直接處理設備多樣性的方法。物聯網中邊緣智能的一個主要目標是從本地數據中提取洞察；安全模型可以利用這些數據來構建本地節點保護，並整合人工智慧模型以產生先進的安全解決方案。本研究提出了一種新穎的深度學習算法，用於在邊緣有效檢測入侵，並得到雲端物聯網框架的支持。我們評估了所提出的跨模態深度學習算法與基準模型的表現。其貢獻是一種跨領域的深度神經網絡（DNN）算法，用於入侵檢測。目標是評估一種多方法深度學習模型，以通過建模注意力進行社群檢測，在邊緣檢測物聯網系統中的入侵。我們評估了GCT自編碼器，這是一個整合邊緣智能以識別安全漏洞的新穎框架。該模型顯著提高了性能和效率。在涵蓋多種攻擊場景的網路入侵物聯網數據集上，它達到了0.908的準確率，將學習損失降低至0.00156，並超越了現有的方法。
